title: Creation version certificate
description: What a creation version's certificate says (D763): the payload of a JWS sealed exactly as an answer certificate is (tag:jean.is,2026:answer-certificate, its certificateFile and protectedHeader), a W3C VC 2.0 of type CreationVersion. A provenance file is a JSON array of such certificates, the first made from the others, each ingredient naming its certificate by the base64url SHA-256 of that certificate's signature's ASCII.
